title.zh: 服务器核验的双语密码更新

purpose.en: Apply the Gold v2 password boundary discovered during Konectible migration to SmartLingo's bilingual account settings.
purpose.zh: 将 Konectible 迁移中发现的 Gold v2 密码边界同步到 SmartLingo 双语账户设置。

en: Add or update a password while preserving email-code sign-in.
Show English and Chinese current-password errors from stable server codes.
zh: 添加或更新密码，同时保留邮箱验证码登录。
根据稳定的服务器错误码显示中英文当前密码提示。

en: SmartLingo account password settings and the new password API only.
Courses, learning records, certificates, rewards, referrals, and media are unchanged.
zh: 仅影响 SmartLingo 账户密码设置与新增密码接口。
课程、学习记录、证书、奖励、推荐及媒体均不变。

en: Replace direct client-side Clerk mutation with a bounded authenticated server request.
Verify an existing password server-side and apply independent network/member D1 limits.
Retain SmartLingo's add-versus-update mode and bilingual UI.
zh: 以受限且已认证的服务器请求替换客户端直接修改 Clerk。
在服务器核验已有密码，并分别执行网络／会员 D1 限制。
保留 SmartLingo 新增／更新模式及双语界面。

en: All source and rendered-Worker tests, TypeScript, zero-warning ESLint, sensitive-data scan, and verified production build pass locally.
zh: 全部源码与渲染 Worker 测试、TypeScript、零警告 ESLint、敏感数据扫描及经验证的生产构建均在本地通过。
构建后的 Worker 已提供 /api/account/password。

en: No learning, certificate, reward, payment-rule, provider, or data migration is included.
zh: 本次不包含学习、证书、奖励、付款规则、服务商或数据迁移。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's bilingual password component, Clerk app, Worker, D1, R2, RealtimeKit, course catalog, learning records, and payment resources.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 双语密码组件、Clerk 应用、Worker、D1、R2、RealtimeKit、课程目录、学习记录及付款资源。
